verdict.rationale: Gusto ships an official CLI that is documented for headless and CI use. It authenticates non-interactively via GUSTO_ACCESS_TOKEN/GUSTO_COMPANY_UUID env vars or --token-stdin, supports separate sandbox and production credential slots, and auto-enables a stable JSON envelope when output is piped. It also has documented exit codes, structured auth errors, --dry-run, and a checksummed keyless installer. The underlying REST API adds system access tokens, idempotency keys, and webhooks for unattended automation. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage, and the CLI is pre-1.0 (v0.3.0) with no payroll submit command, so writes require an explicit --confirm.
